subject: Renewal and uplift: HealthGrid AWS Marketplace private offer — coordination
messages:
From: Oliver Banks <oliver.banks@healthgrid.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Renewal + uplift — HealthGrid AWS private offer

Hi Grace —

We're coming up on our renewal window for the AWS private offer (term ends Aug 15). Usage this quarter shows a steady increase across our inference workloads and we'd like to increase committed capacity by ~40% and extend the term to 24 months. We need to finalize paperwork and the PO by mid-July to meet our internal procurement cycle.

Key asks:
- Can Redwood provide a private-offer PO template with the updated commitment and a staged activation schedule?
- We need clarity on invoice split for multi-region usage (us-east-1 + us-west-2) and whether billing can be tranching over the first 6 months.
- Any SLAs or acceptance windows we should be aware of for a stepped capacity increase?

I can loop in our procurement mailbox (procure@healthgrid.com) once we have the template. Also, can you flag if there are any required tax forms?

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call this week if helpful.

Oliver Banks
VP, Procurement
HealthGrid

Attachments: usage_summary_q2.csv (referenced)

Hi Oliver —

Thanks for the heads up and congrats on the growth — good problem to have. I copied Ben (contracts + marketplace ops) and Kim (enterprise sales lead) so they can weigh in on the acceptance and billing patterns.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to send a proposed PO template reflecting a 24-month term and a staircase-style capacity uplift (40% upfront, then 15% after month 6) so your finance team can review.
2) Kim to confirm whether we can support a tranching invoice cadence across regions and the billing code for multi-region usage.
3) I’ll confirm the target PO delivery date — if we can get a signed PO by July 15 we should hit your procurement cycle.

Quick clarifiers for procurement:
- Does HealthGrid require a tax form (W-9 for US entities) or EU VAT handling?
- Will the PO be signed by a single signatory or staged (legal + CFO)?

If helpful, I can schedule a 20-minute sync with you + procurement to walk through the template.

Thanks,

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Oliver Banks <oliver.banks@healthgrid.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 13:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + uplift — HealthGrid AWS private offer

Oliver / Grace —

Attached is a proposed_po_template.pdf (see attachment stub) that follows the AWS Private Offer pattern. Key points baked into the template:
- Term: 24 months starting on date of acceptance
- Commitment: baseline + staircase uplift (40% initial committed increase, +15% at month 6)
- Billing: quarterly invoicing recommended. We can split invoices by region if HealthGrid prefers separate line items for us-east-1 and us-west-2.
- Acceptance window: 30 days after PoA (we typically allow a 30-day evidence/acceptance window; acceptance terms are on p.2).
- SLA: standard Redwood marketplace SLA applies; for Dedicated/Private offers we can add a SLA uplift if you need tighter latency targets — add-on pricing applies.

I've also included a short Acceptance_SLA-summary.xlsx to show SLA uplift tiers.

Action items for HealthGrid procurement:
- Confirm signatory and tax requirements (W-9 / VAT ID).
- Confirm if you'd like tranche invoicing split equally across first two quarters or weighted to usage.

If you want, I can draft the DocuSign envelope once the PO file is final.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: proposed_po_template.pdf (PDF stub), Acceptance_SLA-summary.xlsx (XLSX stub)

From: procure@healthgrid.com
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jul 2028 09:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + uplift — HealthGrid AWS private offer

Hi Ben / Grace —

Thanks for the template and the notes. A couple of clarifying items from procurement:

1) Signatory: PO will be signed by our legal director and countersigned by CFO; please include both signature blocks on the PO if possible.
2) Tax: HealthGrid is US-headquartered — we'll need a completed W-9 attached to the PO. Please include Redwood's tax details on the PO and also email a W-9 PDF.
3) Invoice cadence: Procurement prefers tranching split across the first two quarters (60% / 40%) rather than equal tranches to match expected spend. Can you reflect that in the PO?
4) Evidence window: 30 days is fine, but we need a graceful fallback if production issues delay activation (requesting an extension clause).

Finally, please send the DocuSign link once the final PO and the W-9 are attached. We aim to return signature by July 20.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
HealthGrid
procure@healthgrid.com

- Timeline: target PO out today (7/4) -> DocuSign by 7/5 -> signatures returned by 7/20 to meet your cycle.
